description: Project-wide Claude Code settings for RAVL framework

hooks._comment_git_commit: Uncomment the section below to enable copyright checking before git commits

hooks.command:
python3 .claude/scripts/copyright_manager.py check --priority priority_1 priority_2 priority_3 2>&1 | grep -E '(MISSING|INVALID)' && echo '
⚠️  Warning: Some files are missing copyright headers. Run /copyright-add to fix.' || true
